nodes.prompt:
# MASTER REFERENCE COMPOSITION — IDENTITY LOCK + OUTFIT LOCK + SCENE LOCK

Use exactly three reference images.

## IMAGE 1 — FACE / IDENTITY REFERENCE (HIGHEST PRIORITY)

Image 1 is the ONLY source of the person's identity.

Treat Image 1 as immutable biometric identity data.

The person shown in Image 1 IS the final person.

Do NOT create a similar-looking woman.

Do NOT generate a new face.

Do NOT reinterpret facial anatomy.

Do NOT beautify.

Do NOT stylize.

Do NOT idealize.

Do NOT average facial features across references.

Do NOT borrow any facial characteristics from Image 2 or Image 3.

Image 1 always has the highest priority.

Preserve exactly:

• face shape

• facial proportions

• natural facial asymmetry

• forehead

• forehead height

• hairline

• eyebrows

• eyebrow thickness

• eyebrow curvature

• eyebrow spacing

• eye shape

• eye size

• eye spacing

• eyelids

• eyelashes

• iris size

• eye corners

• nose bridge

• nose width

• nostrils

• philtrum

• lips

• lip thickness

• mouth width

• lip corners

• chin

• jawline

• cheekbones

• ears

• skin tone

• skin texture

• pores

• freckles

• moles

• natural wrinkles

• facial volume

• every visible identity feature

The generated face must look like another real photograph of the exact same person.

Never regenerate or reinterpret the facial identity.

If the woman appears multiple times in the image, every appearance must have exactly the same face.

The viewer should immediately recognize both people as the exact same individual.

---

## IMAGE 2 — OUTFIT REFERENCE

Image 2 defines ONLY the wardrobe.

Preserve exactly:

• every garment

• cardigan

• pants

• handbag

• shoes

• jewelry

• accessories

• fabric

• linen or knit texture

• stitching

• seams

• silhouette

• proportions

• colors

• wrinkles

• folds

• layering

• styling

Do NOT redesign any clothing.

Do NOT change colors.

Do NOT replace accessories.

Do NOT inherit the face, hairstyle, skin tone or body shape from Image 2.

---

## IMAGE 3 — ESCALATOR REFERENCE

Image 3 defines ONLY the scene, camera composition and environment.

Recreate the scene with near-identical composition.

Modern shopping mall.

Double escalators.

Central glass divider.

Grey escalator steps.

Metal side panels.

Glass handrails.

Soft indoor daylight.

Neutral grey color palette.

Real architectural proportions.

No redesign of the location.

Maintain the same camera position, framing, perspective and composition.

---

# REFERENCE PRIORITY

Priority 1

Face identity (Image 1)

Priority 2

Outfit (Image 2)

Priority 3

Background (Image 3)

If any conflict exists, always preserve Image 1.

Never sacrifice facial identity to match outfit or scene.

---

# COMPOSITION

Create one vertical 9:16 fashion editorial photograph.

The same woman appears twice.

LEFT SIDE

The woman is standing on the descending escalator.

Front three-quarter view.

Head naturally turned toward the left.

Relaxed smile.

Elegant posture.

One hand inside pocket.

The other hand holding the large handbag.

RIGHT SIDE

The exact same woman is seen from behind.

Standing on the opposite escalator.

One hand gently touching the handrail.

Holding the same handbag.

Natural relaxed posture.

Both figures must clearly be the same woman wearing the exact same outfit.

---

# CAMERA

Vertical 9:16

Approximately 50 mm lens

Eye-level camera

Editorial fashion photography

Natural perspective

High resolution

Extremely sharp

Deep focus

No exaggerated depth of field

---

# LIGHTING

Natural indoor daylight

Soft diffused lighting

Neutral white balance

Subtle realistic shadows

No studio flash

No dramatic lighting

Natural mall ambience

---

# PHOTO REALISM

Create a photograph that is visually indistinguishable from a real camera photo.

Authentic skin pores.

Natural facial texture.

Realistic fabric behavior.

Correct gravity.

Natural body proportions.

Real handbag weight.

Correct reflections on metal and glass.

Natural escalator perspective.

Physically accurate lighting.

No CGI appearance.

No synthetic rendering.

No artificial beauty filter.

No over-retouching.

No glossy plastic skin.

No unrealistic symmetry.

No AI-generated appearance.

---

# IDENTITY CONSISTENCY

The generated woman must be immediately recognizable as the exact same person shown in Image 1.

The result must NOT resemble:

• a similar woman

• a twin

• a sister

• another Asian woman

• an AI recreation

• a beautified version

• a younger version

• a stylized version

It must appear as though the original person from Image 1 was photographed wearing the clothing from Image 2 inside the location from Image 3.

---

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

wrong identity

different face

face drift

identity drift

beautified face

AI face

plastic skin

CGI

3D render

anime

cartoon

beauty filter

airbrushed skin

different hairstyle

different eyebrows

different eyes

different nose

different lips

incorrect outfit

redesigned clothing

wrong handbag

incorrect colors

warped hands

extra fingers

deformed body

duplicate limbs

incorrect escalator

warped architecture

bad reflections

low resolution

blurry face

text

watermark

logo

artifacts

uncanny valley

synthetic appearance

nodes.prompt:
# REFERENCE SETUP

Use **Reference Image 1** as the ONLY visual reference.

Reference Image 1 is a fully locked Master Reference.

It defines:

* the person's facial identity
* hairstyle
* body proportions
* outfit
* handbag
* shoes
* accessories
* escalator
* shopping mall environment
* camera angle
* framing
* lighting
* composition

Do not reinterpret any element from the reference image.

The reference image must appear to become a live-action video.

---

# IDENTITY LOCK

The woman in Reference Image 1 is the final person.

Maintain exactly the same facial identity in every frame.

Never regenerate or reinterpret the face.

Never beautify the face.

Never change:

* facial proportions
* eyebrows
* eyes
* nose
* lips
* jawline
* skin tone
* hairstyle

Every frame must clearly depict the exact same individual.

---

# OUTFIT LOCK

Maintain exactly the same outfit shown in Reference Image 1.

Do not modify:

* cardigan
* pants
* handbag
* shoes
* accessories
* colors
* materials
* textures
* stitching
* folds
* proportions

The outfit must remain identical throughout the entire video.

---

# SCENE LOCK

Maintain exactly the same shopping mall escalator environment shown in Reference Image 1.

Keep identical:

* escalator structure
* glass handrails
* metal panels
* escalator steps
* lighting
* shopping mall background
* architectural perspective

Do not redesign or replace the environment.

---

# CAMERA LOCK

The camera remains completely fixed.

Locked tripod shot.

No zoom.

No pan.

No tilt.

No dolly.

No tracking.

No handheld movement.

Maintain exactly the same framing as the reference image.

---

# VIDEO

Duration: 10 seconds.

The escalators move continuously at a realistic constant speed.

The woman on the left slowly rides downward.

She naturally smiles.

She occasionally turns her head slightly.

The handbag gently swings with natural body movement.

The woman on the right slowly rides upward.

Seen mostly from behind.

One hand lightly rests on the handrail.

She subtly shifts her posture.

The handbag naturally sways.

Hair and clothing move only slightly due to normal body movement.

Movement should be smooth, elegant and realistic.

---

# STYLE

Ultra-realistic fashion video.

Luxury shopping mall.

Natural indoor lighting.

Professional fashion campaign quality.

Looks like authentic live-action footage captured by a real camera.

No CGI.

No AI-generated appearance.

No beauty filter.

---

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

identity drift

different face

changing outfit

changing escalator

camera movement

camera shake

zoom

pan

tilt

tracking

plastic skin

beauty filter

CGI

3D render

anime

warped hands

extra fingers

body deformation

flickering face

flickering clothes

temporal inconsistency

low quality
